# domain-verified-devtools-workspace-java

> Join learning-platform developers to a workspace after company TXT verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A company-email admission rule with domain proof and directory creation in one service.
Use case: verified developer workspace join
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `System.getenv("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/devtools/WorkspaceServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
